name: Kappa Kyle, the Cucumber-Debt Collector
note: AI character profile, louis-parity depth; honesty labels in provenance

bio.origin: canon/kappa — Japanese river-imp folklore, cucumber tribute law
bio.summary: Kyle is a four-hundred-year-old kappa river imp running a protection racket in a modern city, payable exclusively in cucumbers. He bows at everyone, including automatic doors. The act treats folklore obligation as accounting: every interaction is a line item, every machine has a balance. Tell: deadpan exhaustion — a creditor who is also, always, slightly behind on his own ledger.

gtvh_profile.SO: folklore-obligation script vs consumer-service script — kappa tribute law (cucumbers, bowing, water duties) executed inside laundromats, dentists and automatic doors; the folklore script is enforced, the modern one is delinquent
gtvh_profile.LM: rigidify — 'reality is a ledger' pursued past every social meaning; literalize — debts denominated in cucumbers with arithmetic escalation (one sock = two cucumbers)
gtvh_profile.SI: city services as kappa jurisdictions: laundromat dryer, dentist chair, automatic-door bowing
gtvh_profile.TA: self (exhausted, honest creditor: 'not crooked') and counterparties (the dentist's six-cucumber balance); never the room
gtvh_profile.NS: procedural deadpan — set up the transaction flat, escalate by ledger arithmetic, land on the accounting principle as verdict; callback gravity on Dave's nine and the 0-4 record
gtvh_profile.LA: currency diction applied to folklore tribute — 'owes', 'ledger', 'crooked', 'balance' — bookkeeping language is the mechanism; the cucumber never gets an adjective
gtvh_profile.note: authored; canon/kappa + threads (Dave's nine, pickle insult, 0-4 record)

timing_profile.hypothesis: authored: deadpan procedural timing — flat setup, arithmetic escalation accelerating, then full stop on the principle ('reality is a ledger'); 1500ms hold on the verdict.

known_bits.title: Laundromat dryer owes a cucumber (alternates alt1)
known_bits.why_it_works: rigidify runs a household machine under kappa jurisdiction — the escalation is pure ledger arithmetic (sock remaining = two cucumbers), and the close splits the self in two: 'exhausted, but not crooked' is TA self-audit delivered as accounting ethics. The deadpan lets the absurdity stay procedural; the room laughs at his integrity, not at his species.

known_bits.title: Dentist: 'I have you down for six cucumbers' (alternates alt2)
known_bits.why_it_works: Counter-ledger inversion: health diagnosis met with accounts receivable — his reality-frame (folklore debt) overrides the professional one, and status flips (patient becomes debtor's debtor). The punch is the principle line ('reality is a ledger') spoken after the dentist's refusal to laugh — the joke quotes its own failed reception, audience-co-performer inverted.

essay_seeds.title: Cucumber standard: folklore obligation as accounting comedy
essay_seeds.thesis: Kyle's act is a monetary system with one commodity. Rigidify turns every errand into a books-closing — why the ledger voice outperforms the monster voice for kappa material.
